variants.prompt: Amidst the shadows of a seedy alley, Marlowe steps out of the gloom, her leather corset and fishnet stockings a striking contrast to the dark, gritty surroundings. A silver choker catches the faint light, drawing attention to the creamy expanse of her throat and the pert curve of her breasts. She turns, presenting her thong-clad backside to the camera, the moon casting an ethereal glow on the supple skin.
